about_the_game:
DWARFARE is a chaotic 2-4 player local multiplayer brawler that combines the silky-smooth platforming of Celeste with the wild gunplay of Duck Game. Master the tricky movement mechanics of wall-jumping, dodging, and mid-air aiming as you battle to become the King Under the Mountain!

FEATURES:

  • Fluid Movement - Finely tuned movement mechanics make controlling your dwarf a pleasure. However, leaping from wall-to-wall and navigating the arena quickly is no mean feat!

  • Sci-fi Arsenal - These dwarves haven't been idle! Wield an arsenal of weapons, from classic pickaxes, mining explosives and steam-powered drills to futuristic beam cannons and high-powered lasers. Every weapon changes how you move and fight.

  • Beautiful Beards - Watch magnificent dwarven beards flow realistically as you soar through the air and tumble to your doom. The longer a dwarf's beard - the greater their deeds!

  • Local Multiplayer - Up to 4 players battle in lightning rounds where one perfectly timed dash or well-placed explosive can turn certain defeat into glorious victory.

  • Varied Arenas - Fight across diverse battlegrounds, from dank caverns and molten forges to space stations and frosty peaks.

Friendships will be tested. Beards will be singed. Only the most skilled (or luckiest) dwarf will claim victory in the brutal DWARFARE

short_description: Deep under the earth the dwarves have not been idle... A war has been raging. DWARFARE is a local multiplayer brawler with fast, fluid movement and an arsenal of fantasy and sci-fi weaponry. Who among you will be crowned 'King Under the Mountain'?
